title: Stream Ella Langley’s Exclusive SiriusXM Concert in Denver
summary: The country star performed hits, fan favorites, and songs from her latest album, “Dandelion,” at The Grizzly Rose.
body_markdown:
[Ella Langley](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/ella-langley) performed a special SiriusXM performance, presented by REESE’S, at The Grizzly Rose on Tuesday, October 6 and SiriusXM listeners can relive the[Small Stage Series](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/small-stage-series) show anytime on[The Highway](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-highway) .


[Small Stage Series: Ella Langley Exclusive concert at the Grizzly Rose in Denver Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogEllaLangleySSS-TheHighway)


### **How to Listen to Ella Langley’s Small Stage Series Concert**


The exclusive performance aired on The Highway (Ch. 56) on Friday, October 9 at 8pm ET, and is available to listen to anytime on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogEllaLangleySSS-TheHighway) .


- **Related:[Listen to Lainey Wilson’s Exclusive Small Stage Series Concert](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/lainey-wilson-small-stage-series)**


The exclusive concert featured Ella performing her hits, fan favorites, and songs from her[latest album, “Dandelion.”](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/ella-langley-dandelion-lyrics-meaning)


Ella Langley backstage at her “Small Stage Series” show in Denver. (Credit Maro Hagopian)


### **SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series**


Launched in 2021, SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series brings major artists to intimate, iconic venues for exclusive performances.


- **Related:[Miranda Lambert Opens Up About Her Friendship with Ella Langley](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/miranda-lambert-kacey-musgraves-reunion)**


Previous Small Stage Series performers include Alicia Keys, Brandi Carlile, Coldplay, Dave Matthews, Ed Sheeran, Green Day, H.E.R., Hilary Duff, J Balvin, J. Cole, Jason Aldean, Kane Brown, Kenny Chesney, Lainey Wilson, and more.
